Container.Name: AIWebBuilder
Container.Overview: AI Web Builder is an open-source AI-powered website generator that transforms natural language descriptions into production-grade websites. Supports Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and 10+ AI providers. Local-first architecture with 13 production layers (Frontend, API, Database, Auth, Deployment, CI/CD, Security, Rate Limiting, Caching, Load Balancing, Error Tracking, Recovery).

Requires.name: Ollama
Requires.description: AI inference engine for local model execution

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web interface port for the AI Web Builder application.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for generated projects, settings, and user data.

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: URL of your Ollama instance. Use http://ollama:11434 if running the Ollama container alongside, or enter your host IP if Ollama is on the host or another machine.

Config.Name: OpenAI API Key
Config.Description: API key for OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini). Leave blank if using local providers only.

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: API key for Anthropic Claude (Sonnet 4, Haiku, Opus). Leave blank if using local providers only.

Config.Name: Gemini API Key
Config.Description: API key for Google Gemini (2.5 Pro, 2.5 Flash). Leave blank if using local providers only.

Config.Name: Groq API Key
Config.Description: API key for Groq (LLaMA 3.3, Mixtral, DeepSeek R1). Leave blank if using local providers only.

Config.Name: DeepSeek API Key
Config.Description: API key for DeepSeek Chat. Leave blank if using local providers only.

Config.Name: Mistral API Key
Config.Description: API key for Mistral AI (Mistral Large, Codestral). Leave blank if using local providers only.

Config.Name: OpenRouter API Key
Config.Description: API key for OpenRouter (200+ models unified API). Leave blank if using local providers only.

Config.Name: Pexels API Key
Config.Description: API key for Pexels royalty-free stock photos. Leave blank for fallback placeholders.

Config.Name: Unsplash API Key
Config.Description: API key for Unsplash royalty-free stock photos. Leave blank for fallback placeholders.

Config.Name: Together API Key
Config.Description: API key for Together AI. Leave blank if using local providers only.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn, error.

Config.Name: Node Environment
Config.Description: Node.js environment mode.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Tokyo).

Config.Name: Container Hostname
Config.Description: Bind address for the web server.

Config.Name: Max Generation Tokens
Config.Description: Maximum tokens for AI-generated content. Higher values allow longer output but consume more memory.

Config.Name: Temperature
Config.Description: AI generation temperature (0.0-2.0). Lower = more deterministic, higher = more creative.

Config.Name: Memory Limit
Config.Description: Memory limit for the container in MB (e.g., 2048). 0 = unlimited.

Config.Name: CPU Pin
Config.Description: Pin container to specific CPU cores (e.g., 0-3 or 0,2,4). Leave blank for all cores.

Config.Name: Extra Parameters
Config.Description: Additional Docker run command parameters.

Config.Name: Privileged Mode
Config.Description: Run container in privileged mode. Not recommended unless required.

Config.Name: Show Console Output
Config.Description: Enable to show console output in the Unraid log.

Label.Name: org.opencontainers.image.description
Label.Value: Open-source AI-powered website generator with 13-layer production architecture, supporting Ollama and 10+ AI providers.
